properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in Texas...

Neches River at Neches River Saltwater Barrier affecting Jasper,
Orange, Jefferson and Hardin Counties.

Village Creek Near Kountze affecting Hardin County.

Pine Island Bayou Near Sour Lake affecting Jefferson and Hardin
Counties.

For the Neches River...including Town Bluff, Evadale, Neches River
Saltwater Barrier...Minor flooding is forecast.
For the Village Creek...including Kountze...Minor flooding is
forecast.
For the Pine Island Bayou...including Sour Lake...Minor flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Village Creek near Kountze.

* WHEN...Until Sunday evening.

* IMPACTS...At 20.0 feet, Water begins to flow over the bridge on
Farm to Market Road 418. Water also begins to cover F.M. 418 at
several other locations. Road in Village Creek State Park begins to
have water across it.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 9:30 AM CDT Saturday the stage was 20.7 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 12.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 9:30 AM CDT Saturday was 21.8 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage late
tomorrow morning and continue falling to 6.8 feet Thursday
morning.
- Flood stage is 17.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 20.8
feet on 01/09/1998.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:

deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 5 at 5:59PM EDT until September 5 at 6:45PM EDT by NWS Raleigh NC
properties.description:
SVRRAH

The National Weather Service in Raleigh has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Southeastern Sampson County in central North Carolina...

* Until 645 PM EDT.

* At 559 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm was located over Warsaw,
moving east at 45 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and nickel size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Clinton, Harrells, Turkey, and Ivanhoe.

This includes Interstate 40 between Mile Markers 356 and 359.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

Straight line winds can blow down trees, power lines, and damage
mobile homes and other buildings. Seek shelter in a sturdy structure
until the storm has passed. Stay away from windows as flying debris
generated by damaging winds can be deadly.

properties.description:

miles southwest of Shields, or 53 miles west of Linton, moving
northeast at 20 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and half dollar size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to

Locations impacted include...
Selfridge, Shields, Standing Rock and Porcupine.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. This storm is capable of producing damaging winds and large
hail.

properties.description:
SMWMHX

The National Weather Service in Newport has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Neuse and Bay Rivers...

* Until 630 PM EDT.

* At 532 PM EDT, a strong thunderstorm was located near The Vicinity
Of Slocum Creek, or 15 nm west of Oriental, moving northeast at 15
knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts to 40 knots.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Small craft could be damaged in briefly higher winds and
suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
The Vicinity Of Hancock Creek, The Vicinity Of Slocum Creek, The
Vicinity Of Clubfoot Creek, Oriental, Mid Point Of Cherry
Branch-Minnesott Beach Ferry Terminal, The Vicinity Of Adams Creek,
and The Vicinity Of South River.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor immediately as gusty winds and high waves are
expected.

Frequent lightning is occurring with this storm. If caught on the
open water stay below deck if possible, keep away from ungrounded
metal objects.
